notes: «قال أبو عيسى» is the compiler's own words (rule 13), not written; «بهذا الإسناد» closes the route as a back_reference

«نحو حديث ابن أبي عمر» is wording; «وفي الباب عن عمر» and the grading remarks are not routes; the later «حدثنا بذلك أحمد بن عبدة» is about Ibn al-Mubarak's view on raising the hands, not the same saying (rule 4)
